thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGER fired for `gpu-pool-prod-us-west-2` - metric `gpu_memory_pressure` > 85% (5m avg). PagerDuty INC-4829 auto-created and escalated to primary on-call.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-4829 triggered (severity: P1). Notified: @jamie (primary).

jamie: acked. I'm on it — jumping into metrics and logs now. tagging @selena and @luis.

nate: seeing increased realtime evictions and `cuda` OOM spikes on the grafana dash for pool `gpu-pool-prod-us-west-2`. heatmap -> nodes gpu-12, gpu-15 showing memory climb.

selena: logs from gpu-12 show repeated CUDA OOM allocation failures. grabbing a tail: 
```
2026-03-15T10:22:01Z ERROR model-server gpu-12 kernel: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory while allocating 268435456 bytes
2026-03-15T10:22:03Z ERROR runner gpu-12 worker: failed to init KV cache, cuda: out of memory
2026-03-15T10:22:10Z WARN  kvcache gpu-12: eviction fallback triggered, 12 requests dropped
```

luis: running quick healthcheck on the node: `ssh gpu-12` — memory looks fragmented, a few long-lived pinned allocations from model shard processes. Suggest cordon + drain then migrate workloads to fallback routing.

jamie: initiating mitigations — will perform an immediate routing change to move new requests to `fallback-model-small` and scale up `gpu-pool-prod-us-west-2` by 2 GPUs. 

jamie: running routing change (internal API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/overrides \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"service":"text-gen","from_pool":"gpu-pool-prod-us-west-2","to_variant":"fallback-model-small","mode":"gradual","weight":0.8}'
```

jamie: changed to gradual routing (80% to fallback-model-small, 20% still to original while we drain). will monitor latency/quality.

luis: scaling dedicated pool: requested `gpu-pool-prod-us-west-2` +2 gpus via infra API. ETA ~90s for instance spin and scheduler attach.

selena: kicking off cordon/drain on gpu-12 to flush pinned allocations: 
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-12
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30
```

incident-bot: Auto-shedder active: migration started for 18 inflight tasks; prefetched caches will be invalidated.

nate: while draining, we still see intermittent `cuda: device-side assert` and `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` traces for tasks that re-scheduled to the same pool — increasing fallback weight to 1.0 to stop further traffic to the pool.

jamie: updated routing override to 100% fallback.

maria: support notify: opening support ticket SUP-193 for customers hitting 503s; posting to status page draft. tagging comms for public update if customer impact confirmed.

selena: after drain started, node gpu-12 freed up ~18 GiB over 4 minutes, but fragmentation remained. will hold node offline for deeper investigation.

luis: new instances came up and attached to pool ~120s after request. health checks green.

nate: metrics summary during event window:
- inbound qps spike: +15% around 10:21
- avg token latency (fallback): +12% but within SLO
- error spike (503/timeout): 2.1% of requests for the 6 minute window

jamie: current customer impact: small subset (~2% of active requests during window) experienced errors or higher latency while we rerouted. support notified.

maria: created incident note in Zendesk ticket, assigned to tier2; will send targeted outbound to customers reporting errors.

pagerduty: PagerDuty INC-4829 acknowledged by jamie at 2026-03-15T10:23:10Z.

selena: adding post-incident actions: 
- investigate long-lived pinned allocations and model shard memory accounting on gpu-12
- verify kvcache eviction policy adjustments to avoid drop spikes
- add a heuristic to prefer node defragmentation/eviction before hard kill for high-throughput pools

luis: infra action: capture full cuda memreport and nvtop snapshot from gpu-12, save to s3://infra-artifacts/incidents/INC-4829/

jamie: closing the pager for now — routing stable to fallback, new capacity healthy. leaving gpu-12 cordoned. will follow up with postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow. thanks all. :heart: 

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-4829 status changed to RESOLVED by jamie at 2026-03-15T10:30:54Z.

maria: note for PMs: affected feature: streaming chat on `text-gen` route; recommended to run regression against fallback-model-small prompts to validate quality drift.

selena: assigning myself to the follow-up; will include a timeline + reproduction of OOM with a smaller repro harness.

jamie: thanks team. I'll draft the on-call timeline and customer impact numbers.
